## Definition of Done

- [ ] Acceptance criteria of the feature spec are met
- [ ] Tests at the right level (domain logic test-driven; bug fixes have a regression test)
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally (format, lint, types, architecture, tokens, tests, licences)
- [ ] UI: keyboard-accessible, works in list mode, uses design tokens, EN + DE strings
- [ ] Docs updated (feature spec, glossary, ADR if an architecture decision changed)
- [ ] **Privacy:** this change does not persist or log presence data or personal data (ADR-0012)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
